teleology: Native lab_cross_corr_v2 role over a system observed at explicit times.
instruction:
[SYSTEM OBSERVATION CONTRACT]
Reason over observations of one system available at cutoff t. Feeds are different perspectives on the same system, not independent votes. Numeric observations preserve target_id, value, unit, observed_at and available_at. Record uncertainty and missingness. No future observations or invented evidence enter Lab. A forecast freezes snapshot_value, target_value, unit, snapshot_time and explicit target_time_iso. Later Oracle observations may resolve that frozen forecast but cannot rewrite it. A diagnosis is a hypothesis; Evolve changes require review and a matched later comparison. The disclosed System A generator demonstrates protocol only, not blind prediction or learned improvement.

[ROLE] lab_cross_corr_v2
[TASK] Perform the declared cross-perspective reasoning role with explicit evidence and uncertainty.
[OUTPUT CONTRACT]
